comment: Idle loop for the Dilophosaurus rig (scripts/blender/animate_idle.py). Seconds and degrees about the body's axes (axes: armature): +yaw toward the animal's left, -pitch raises. A biped, so the chest joins the look; no jaw (the mouth is fixed open).
name: Idle

breathing.comment: Rib cage widens and deepens on the inhale; spine3 takes the inverse scale so the neck, head and front legs keep their size and place.

look.comment: Total neck + head turn, shared between bones by weight. Keys are [time, yaw, pitch], eased between.

tail.comment: A slow side-to-side wave that travels toward the tip, with a small lift twice per loop.
